notes:
REF-BM-02: Metadata collection handles title and description only; favicon and preview image are missing.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, description, and tags are editable, but bookmarks have no note field.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate URLs are detected, but the UI offers opening the target URL or saving another copy rather than editing the existing bookmark.
REF-BM-07: Cards expose title, description, and tags, but no favicon is stored or displayed.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry is a plain comma-separated input without autocomplete.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, and URL, but there is no note content to search.
REF-BM-14: Search does not parse #tag syntax.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised expressions are not parsed.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases receive no exact-phrase handling.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action implementation.
REF-BM-21: There is no whole-filtered-collection bulk action.
REF-BM-23: Bookmark notes and markdown rendering are absent.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshots are absent.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is absent.
REF-BM-26: Bookmarks cannot be archived.
REF-BM-27: No reversible archive lifecycle exists; only permanent deletion is implemented.
REF-BM-28: There is no archived-bookmarks view.
REF-BM-29: Saved filter bundles are absent.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is absent.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is absent.
REF-BM-32: No persistent personal display settings are implemented.
